ProjectConnectFlow.entryMode is optional and defaults to choose. Add mode does not present the existing-connection catalog as an observation/resume task.

For an already selected authorized project, initialize(add) completes the existing identity/checkpoint/preset/directory/catalog reads before invoking existing add() after the initialization request settles. It does not resume an existing binding or submit Test/Finish.
All projects does not invent a new project: Add mode remains at explicit project selection and disables Add until an authorized project is selected.

A retained unknown request takes precedence over Add intent. Concurrent initialization is blocked, and incomplete catalogs or a project absent from the authorized directory cannot allocate a new draft.

Selecting a project from All checks that exact identity/server/workspace checkpoint key and restores its retained request before exposing Add. Manual add() also revalidates project directory membership.
